tasks.label: CMake: Build MainBoard Release
tasks.detail: Build with the Release CMake preset. The project CMake environment selects GNU STM32 14.3.1+st.2.

tasks.label: Flash MainBoard via ST-LINK
tasks.detail: Flash and verify build/Release/MainBoard.elf via ST-LINK/SWD, then reset. STM32CubeProgrammer is invoked by absolute path, not PATH.

tasks.label: Build + Flash MainBoard (Release)
tasks.detail: Build Release, then flash and reset the target via ST-LINK.
